Title: [P0][auth][frontend] Prevent false logout on LLM test 401
Description: Gate global unauthorized notification in API and SSE clients so only real session-expired responses trigger logout; keep LLM key/auth errors visible without clearing login state.
Acceptance: When /api/llm/test returns 401 with LLM_AUTH_ERROR or LLM_KEY_MISSING user remains logged in; when 401 code is UNAUTHORIZED app still emits unauthorized event and logs out.
Test_Method: cd frontend; npm test -- unauthorizedPolicy.test.ts; cd frontend; npm run build
